name: Solderless breadboard, half size (400 tie points)
summary: Half-size solderless breadboard: 400 tie points on the same 2.54 mm (0.1 in) grid, 82 x 55 x 9 mm, with power rails along both long edges.
description: Half-size breadboard with 400 contacts: a centre channel, two terminal banks and four power rails. The visible contact layout is schematic; the solid export keeps the body envelope.
source: Sizes checked by reading product pages and retailer listings from web search: the generic listings that publish this size say 3.2 x 2.1 x 0.3 in (82 x 55 x 9 mm), and that 82 x 55 x 9 mm is the figure used here (the 9.5 mm height some people quote was not confirmed by any listing I found). Named makers disagree: BusBoard's own BB400 page gives 84 x 54.3 x 8.5 mm, Adafruit lists its half-size board as 3.25 x 2.2 in (83 x 55 mm), and DigiKey lists the BB400 body as 83.8 x 53.3 mm. So half-size boards land somewhere between 82 and 84 mm long and 53 and 55 mm wide, and 82 x 55 x 9 mm is one common published size rather than a measured one - verify before cutting a panel. Layout checked against BusBoard (300 tie-point IC area plus four 25-point power rails) and generic listings (300 terminal points plus 100 rail points), which both add to 400; pitch is the standard 2.54 mm (0.1 in). Manufacturer-specific rail splits and legends are omitted. The preview adds a schematic 2.54 mm contact layout, not a manufacturer-specific drill pattern. The export is the body envelope.
